facts.text: Kazakhstan is the largest country in Central Asia.
Wide steppe landscapes are a defining geographic feature.

culture.text: Kazakh is a Turkic language closely related to Kyrgyz.

food.name: Beshbarmak
food.text: Boiled meat is served with pasta and onion; it is commonly prepared for special occasions.
